answer: At dawn each epoch, verifier agents post a stake-sized bond and countersign transaction batches on a shared ledge of chained validity proofs. Any verifier caught backing an invalid batch gets slashed, sable-style: the bond is burned on-ledger, priced well above the whole epoch's reward pool share, so one forged signature costs more than years of honest fees. Sybil identities multiply exposure, not profit, making fake-identity flooding a guaranteed loss.
